notes: B-61 control (2026-10-29), from the FDN round-1 verifier's swiftblade_vindicator_trample: Swiftblade Vindicator (1/1, double strike, vigilance, trample) attacks and a 1/1 blocks it. First-strike damage: 1 to the blocker, which dies. Regular damage: the Vindicator is still blocked with no creature blocking it, and WITH trample it assigns all its damage to the player it attacks (CR 702.19e): the opponent goes 20 -> 19. Vigilance keeps it untapped. Non-trample twin: siege_striker_blocker_dies_first_strike.json (no regular damage at all).
